rule.rationale: Replay data shows 15N results in 61% drops and 0 crushes, while 22N results in 22% drops but 6 crushes. The safe region for a 0.4kg glass jar is between 15N and 22N. Setting grip to 21N and lowering acceleration to 0.5m/s^2 maximizes hold probability while avoiding the crush limit observed at 22N.
